newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ARAFAT ARRIVES IN ZIMBABWE FOR SOLAR SUMMIT.
newsitem.headline: ARAFAT ARRIVES IN ZIMBABWE FOR SOLAR SUMMIT.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat arrived in Harare on Sunday to attend an international conference called to drum up political backing for the development and use of solar energy.
Arafat, who arrived on a Saudi plane, was met at Harare airport by Zimbabwean President Robert Mugabe, who will chair the two-day conference starting on Monday.

The Palestinian president joins Malaysia's Mathir Mohammad, Pakistan's Farooq Ahmad Khan Leghari and Cape Verde's Antonio Mascarenhas Monteiro who were already in the country with 5,000 other delegates from 100 countries attending the conference.

Zimbabwean officials said they were now expecting 22 world leaders from an original 25 who were scheduled to attend the summit, jointly organised by Zimbabwe and the United Nations Education, Scientific and Cultural Organisation.
